question: O2 vs O4
bug: formatter::format returns ctx.out() instead of visit() result (wrong RETURN ITERATOR; buffer content unaffected)
probe: fmt::format("{}-{}",42,99) AND fmt::format_to(char*, ...) on both versions
verdict: No public-API output difference found (fmt::format and format_to both identical). The fault is in the returned iterator value, not in emitted output; the tests compare strings from fmt::format, so they observe a surface on which the fault does not appear => O2 (wrong API surface). coder2's 'a chained format could expose it' was not borne out by the format_to probe.
